decisions.base: Combine first and second series: 659 numbered Base cards. Equal odds among every Base card; no series-level scarcity.
decisions.rookies: 47 cards per TCDB rookie index; validate against Base identities and mark only indexed RCs.
decisions.inserts: Six actual Blister Inserts. Original one insert per blister package, not wax pack. VCS pack odds remain null pending documented normalization. Full insert checklist imported but not made artificially common.
decisions.excluded: Exclude Prototypes from ordinary packs; no invented parallels.
decisions.pack: Four cards per VCS pack and 24 packs per box.
decisions.release: DRAFT; verify card images, team names, pricing and insert normalization before release.
